title: Médico Nefrologista em Telemedicina (com RQE)
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEFROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Nefrologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Nefrologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.


*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM NEFROLOGIA.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);



Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.



Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.



Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.



Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Project Accountant
description:
Project Financial Controller (Project Accountant)

Fixed-Term Contract – 18 Months

Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil (Initially remote, transitioning to project office)

Language Requirements: Bilingual English & Portuguese


Job Summary

Our client, a leading International Sports Marketing Firm, is supporting multiple high-profile projects connected to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 . They are seeking an experienced Project Financial Controller / Project Accountant to play a critical role in the financial delivery of these projects.


This role partners closely with Project leadership to ensure robust financial control, accurate budgeting, profitability analysis, and full compliance with local legal and tax requirements. You will provide both commercial and operational finance support while coordinating with international finance teams and local professional advisors.


Key Responsibilities

Project Financial Management

  • Maintain and control client budgets, including detailed reporting and variance analysis
  • Monitor project financial performance and profitability across individual project elements
  • Track and report budget status for internal management and group reporting
  • Produce sensitivity and scenario analysis as required by senior leadership

Commercial & Operational Support

  • Provide ongoing commercial finance support to Project Managers and Project Directors
  • Interpret and apply commercial terms within client and supplier contracts
  • Oversee client invoicing processes and manage cash collection

Cash & Working Capital Management

  • Maintain strict cash controls and oversight of working capital
  • Prepare and manage weekly project cashflow forecasts for group submission
  • Act as a key liaison with local banking providers

Compliance & Governance

  • Ensure adherence to group financial controls, processes, and policies
  • Manage and ensure compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, including withholding and import duties
  • Work closely with local professional advisors to address legal, tax, and regulatory requirements

Shared Services & Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Liaise with international shared service centres to ensure efficient financial operations
  • Support cost coding, allocation, approvals, and financial data accuracy
  • Assist with supplier onboarding in coordination with shared service teams

Payroll & HR Support

  • Support preparation and execution of local payroll
  • Collaborate with HR and professional advisors on monthly payroll processes


Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Fully qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent)
  • Fluent in both English and Portuguese (written and spoken)
  • Proven experience in project accounting or working within project-led environments
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to interpret and manage contract terms
  • Solid knowledge of Brazilian laws, tax rules, and business practices
  • Experience operating in a multi-currency environment
  • Advanced Excel skills and strong analytical capability
  • Experience with Workday is desirable


Key Competencies

  • Highly analytical with strong attention to detail
  • Confident communicator able to engage effectively with senior project leaders
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and solutions-focused mindset
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, international project environment
  • Open to feedback with a continuous improvement mindset

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?


Qual será o seu papel?

Você será o principal responsável por transformar dados de comportamento digital em inteligência estratégica para o negócio. Atuará como referência técnica em mensuração e análise de performance web, garantindo que as decisões de produto, marketing e experiência do usuário sejam guiadas por dados confiáveis e bem interpretados. Seu trabalho conecta diretamente o que acontece nas propriedades digitais com os resultados que a empresa busca atingir.

  • Desenvolver e manter dashboards e relatórios de performance digital, acompanhando métricas como tráfego, conversão, engajamento e funis de aquisição
  • Implementar e auditar tags de rastreamento via Google Tag Manager, garantindo a integridade da coleta de dados nas propriedades digitais
  • Realizar análises exploratórias e apresentar insights para times de produto, marketing e liderança, traduzindo dados complexos em recomendações utilizáveis
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com os times de produto e UX para definir eventos de rastreamento, apoiar testes A/B e interpretar resultados de experimentos
  • Colaborar com times de engenharia e BI para estruturar pipelines de dados e garantir a disponibilidade das informações nas ferramentas certas
  • Disseminar a cultura de dados dentro da organização, apoiando outras áreas na utilização e interpretação de métricas digitais



Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Sólida experiência com Google Analytics 4 (GA4) e Google Tag Manager (GTM)
  • Conhecimento em configuração, implantação e estruturação de dataLayer via código (Javascript) ou Google Tag Manager (GTM)
  • Domínio de SQL para extração e análise de dados em ambientes de Data Warehouse (BigQuery, Amazon Redshift ou similar)
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização como Looker Studio, Quicksight, Power BI ou Tableau
  • Capacidade de comunicar análises e recomendações de forma clara para públicos não técnicos
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de mensuração digital: eventos, dimensões, métricas, atribuição e modelos de funil
  • Perfil analítico com autonomia para conduzir projetos de ponta a ponta com poucos direcionamentos
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Gestão de Projetos como JIRA e Confluence
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis como Scrum ou Kanban
  • Capacidade de gerir e disseminar conhecimento técnico com analistas de menor senioridade.



Você pode se destacar se tiver:

  • Experiência com Python ou R para análises mais avançadas (segmentação, modelos preditivos, análise estatística)
  • Conhecer ferramentas de análise de comportamento como Hotjar, Clarity ou similares
  • Vivência com plataformas de CRM Analytics ou dados de mídia paga integrados ao contexto de web analytics (Insider One, Salesforce)
  • Processos de implementação ou migração de ferramentas de analytics (ex: UA → GA4)
  • Migração de dados entre Data Warehouses (Big Query → AWS)
  • Conceitos de privacidade de dados e suas implicações na coleta (LGPD, consentimento, server-side tracking)
  • Plataformas de cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure)

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Revel Street LLC helps corporate event planners discover and reach private dining venues through an extensive, dependable database. We use LLMs extensively to gather and enrich venue data, streamline the event planning workflow, and reduce the time and effort required to source options for events such as private dining, cocktail receptions, and conferences. We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to help us improve data quality, fix existing data issues, and ingest more data from APIs and LLM-based sources to complement our current datasets. Our current stack includes React, TanStack, Cloudflare, Django, and Dagster, and we expect you to design solutions that are scalable, testable, and grounded in core engineering fundamentals.

Responsibilities

You’ll proactively turn ambiguous requirements into well-structured engineering plans. You’ll communicate trade-offs and risks early, and you’ll verify outcomes through hands-on testing. You’ll bring a “build, measure, improve” mindset to performance, reliability, and user experience.

  • Design, build, and maintain dbt pipelines for our analytics and operational workloads
  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT processes to ingest data from multiple APIs and other external sources
  • Set up and manage workflows in orchestration platforms such as Dagster
  • Develop and refine our data models to support analytics, reporting, and downstream products
  • Diagnose and fix data quality issues (duplicates, missing fields, inconsistent formats, incorrect mappings, etc.)
  • Implement robust data cleaning and validation checks
  • Integrate LLM-based data enrichment (e.g., using OpenAI or similar APIs) to improve and complement event data
  • Collaborate with our product and ops team to understand data needs and translate them into technical solutions

Requirements

  • Very high English proficiency (clear communication, strong writing, and the ability to collaborate effectively)
  • At least 3 years of data engineering experience including experience with dbt and the modern data stack
  • Some experience with devops, CI/CD, and database management.
  • At least 6 months of experience working exclusively in an agentic coding environment (e.g., Claude Code, Codex)
  • Ability to understand data engineering fundamentals, not just generate code—debugging, reasoning about behavior, and ensuring correctness
  • Some technical college degree

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
My client, a US Software Company, with offices in Brazil, is seeking seeks a motivated individual to join their Cloud Services team as a Cloud Engineer. This role supports and maintains their cloud environments and DevOps processes in a mixed cloud environment while collaborating with senior engineers on infrastructure improvements and architecture decisions. The position involves implementing and maintaining cloud-based solutions using Terraform Infrastructure as Code (IaC).


Primary Job Duties:

  • Work in an issue and project tracking system to document task details and track time.
  • Support and maintain the current cloud environment, infrastructure resources, applications, and project work.
  • Monitor cloud environment health and performance, troubleshoot and resolve issues.
  • Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure issues with minimal supervision.
  • Design and maintain scalable Terraform infrastructure, including reusable modules and structured patterns for multi-environment or multi-account deployments, with strong practices for state management and version-controlled workflows
  • Collaborate with senior engineers on cloud architecture and design.
  • Maintain environment security using industry best practices and established policies and procedures.
  • Support DevOps practices by working with development teams and stakeholders to maintain cloud resources and troubleshoot deployment issues.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational runbooks.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, technology, and practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure automation, monitoring, deployment workflows, and cost savings.
  • Participate in incident reviews and root cause analysis.
  • Improve system reliability through automation and observability.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are required for the Cloud Engineer II role.

  • Minimum 2 years of experience with systems, infrastructure, or network administration.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience operating infrastructure in AWS.
  • Experience with infrastructure fundamentals including backup and recovery, disaster recovery, networking, and DNS.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows.
  • Proficiency with monitoring, logging, and event analysis tools.
  • Proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices in a version-controlled environment (e.g., Git).
  • Proficiency in a common scripting language such as Python, bash, Perl, Ruby, or similar.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to self-prioritize multiple tasks and execute accordingly.
  • Able to work flexible hours outside normal business hours as required.
  • Strong written communication skills for email, documentation, and knowledge sharing.


Desired Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are highly desirable for the Cloud Engineer II role.

  • Associate degree (AA/AS) in a technical field or equivalent professional experience.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar) for improving engineering productivity.
  • AWS certification(s) such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, SysOps Administrator, or Developer.
  • Experience administering Linux and/or Windows operating systems.
  • Experience managing Active Directory or similar identity and directory services.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to learn and implement new technologies quickly.
  • Desire to gain knowledge and grow in the position.


This role starts at R$10,000 per month

title: Data Analyst
description:
About The Role


You'll join the Reporting & Analytics team at Pride Global — a high-impact, cross-functional group responsible for delivering data-driven insights across our global staffing operations.

This role sits at the center of how the business makes decisions. You’ll be responsible for building the reporting layer that powers executive dashboards, client presentations, and operational insights across the US, Canada, UK, and Brazil.

This is not just a dashboarding role. You’ll translate complex workforce, financial, and market data into clear, actionable narratives used by senior leadership and global business heads.

We need someone who can take ambiguous business questions, structure them into analytical problems, and deliver high-quality reporting solutions end-to-end — from data modeling to final presentation.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and develop Power BI dashboards used in executive-level reporting and client-facing presentations
  • Build self-service reporting solutions that allow business stakeholders to explore data independently
  • Create clean, intuitive, and visually effective dashboards optimized for both desktop and mobile consumption
  • Develop and manage Power BI datasets, workspaces, and deployment pipelines across Dev / UAT / Prod
  • Model data using star and snowflake schemas, applying best practices in DAX and Power Query (M)
  • Integrate and transform data from multiple sources — ATS, VMS/MSP platforms, SQL databases, Excel, SharePoint, and HR/ERP systems
  • Partner with business leaders to understand reporting needs and translate them into structured analytical outputs
  • Present insights and guide stakeholders through dashboards, explaining trends, limitations, and opportunities
  • Support recurring reporting cycles (weekly, monthly, quarterly) with accurate and timely delivery
  • Define and standardize key business metrics (headcount, spend, fill rates, aging, profitability, etc.)
  • Implement data quality checks, anomaly detection, and validation rules within reporting layers
  • Document data models, metric definitions, and reporting logic to ensure long-term scalability and governance


What We’re Looking For

Must have (3–5 years of experience):

  • Strong hands-on experience with Power BI (DAX, Power Query, data modeling, RLS)
  • Solid SQL skills (joins, aggregations, query optimization, working with relational databases)
  • Experience building reporting solutions for operational, workforce, or business performance data
  • Proven ability to design clean, executive-level dashboards with clear storytelling and minimal noise
  • Experience managing Power BI Service (workspaces, refresh schedules, access control, deployments)
  • Ability to translate business needs into analytical solutions and communicate insights effectively
  • Strong English communication skills (you’ll work with global stakeholders daily)


Nice to have:

  • Experience in staffing, workforce, or HR analytics
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, or similar cloud data platforms
  • Basic experience with Python or R for data preparation or automation
  • Exposure to data governance practices (metric standardization, data lineage, documentation)
  • Experience working in cross-functional environments (finance, operations, delivery teams)

  • Contribute to or lead projects designed to implement change initiatives and enhance delivery

What we are looking for:

Who You Are:

Are You Still Curious?

If you’ve read this far, then chances are you’ve got a curious mind—just like us. So, what are you waiting for? Take the leap and apply today. We can’t wait to see where your curiosity leads you—and how it will shape the future of the client.

title: Data Annotator
description:
Who is Blueprint Technologies?

We are a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with a strong presence across the United States and an expanding footprint across Latin America (LATAM). Our teams are united by a shared passion for solving complex problems.


At Blueprint, we use technology as a bridge between strategy and execution. Our people bring diverse perspectives, deep expertise, and real-world experience across industries to help organizations grow, transform, and innovate.


About the Role

We are seeking detail-oriented Labelers / Annotators to evaluate responses generated by AI systems across multiple languages .


This role focuses on side-by-side (SBS) evaluation of outputs from different AI models across real-world scenarios. You will play a key role in improving how AI systems understand and communicate across languages and cultures.


This is not a translation role . It is an evaluation and analysis role requiring strong judgment and attention to detail.


Language Requirement

Fluency in English + at least one of the following languages:

  • Chinese (Simplified and/or Traditional)
  • Japanese
  • Korean
  • Italian
  • German
  • French


What You’ll Work On

You will evaluate AI responses across scenarios such as:

  • General-purpose Q&A
  • Web search results
  • File-based and image-based responses
  • Image and file generation tasks
  • Single-turn and multi-turn conversations


Responsibilities

  • Perform side-by-side (SBS) comparisons of AI-generated responses
  • Evaluate outputs based on:
  • Accuracy
  • Relevance
  • Clarity
  • Instruction-following
  • Identify nuances in tone, meaning, and cultural context across languages
  • Apply detailed, scenario-specific annotation guidelines
  • Maintain consistency and high-quality evaluations


Required Qualifications

  • Professional fluency in English + at least one target language listed above
  • Prior experience with side-by-side (SBS) labeling or annotation
  • Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail
  • Ability to quickly understand and apply structured evaluation frameworks


Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in linguistics, translation, or localization
  • Experience in:
  • AI evaluation
  • Data annotation
  • Search relevance or content quality analysis


Compensation

We offer competitive compensation aligned with local markets and experience.

Estimated hourly range: R$75 – R$85 BRL

Estimated monthly equivalent (full-time): R$12,000 – R$13,600 BRL

Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity.


Training & Qualification

All new hires will complete a structured onboarding program, including:

  • Training sessions and practice exercises
  • Calibration against quality benchmarks
  • Qualification review before moving into production work


Benefits & Employment Structure

This role is hired through an Employer of Record (EOR) partner, ensuring full compliance with local labor laws and payroll requirements.

Employees receive locally compliant benefits, which may include:

  • Statutory benefits (e.g., paid leave, 13th salary where applicable)
  • Social security and healthcare contributions
  • Additional benefits aligned with local market practices


Why Blueprint?

  • Work on cutting-edge AI systems
  • Be part of a global, multilingual team
  • Build highly transferable AI evaluation skills
  • Contribute directly to improving real-world AI experiences


Equal Opportunity Employer

Blueprint Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, or any other protected status.

description:
About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.


The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.


What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.


Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.


As part of your LinkedIn application submission, please use Loom to record a video and email it to us within the next 48 hours, along with your resume and Linkedin profile link. The recording should include both your camera (showing yourself) and your screen as you walk us through a project or piece of code you’re proud of.


Please email the video to with the title of the position you are applying for in the subject line. We look forward to your submission!

  • Interest in bringing diverse, innovative applications to life.

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: Médico Oncologista Genético (com RQE)
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ONCOLOGISTA GENÉTICO NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Oncologia Genética! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Oncologia Genética, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.


*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Oncologista Genético de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios oncológicos.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de ordem Oncologista Genética.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Oncologista Genética.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ONCOLOGIA.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Oncologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);



Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Oncologia sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.



Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.



Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Title: Data Scientist

Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Contract


Mandatory Skills

• Mathematical Optimization

• Advanced Programming

• Operations & Supply Chain Domain Expertise

• statistical modeling

• Machine Learning

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical Data Scientist to serve as a technical cornerstone within our Supply Chain organization. This role sits at the intersection of Mathematical Optimization, Statistics, and Software Engineering, focusing on uncovering hidden insights and driving data-driven decision-making. You will be responsible for designing and deploying innovative prescriptive analytics solutions that optimize our global operations at strategic, tactical, and operational levels.

Key Responsibilities

• Advanced Modeling : Develop and deploy complex mathematical programming models (MILP, NLP, etc.) to optimize long-term supply chain and manufacturing processes.

• End-to-End Analytics : Perform statistical analysis on diverse healthcare datasets (structured and unstructured) to extract actionable business intelligence.

• Algorithmic Development : Design and implement custom computational solutions using high-performance languages like Julia, Python, or Mosel.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with stakeholders across the organization to translate ambiguous business problems into rigorous technical requirements and scalable solutions.

• Tool Integration : Leverage industry-leading solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, BARON) to solve large-scale resource allocation, scheduling, and inventory challenges.

Required Qualifications

• M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.

• Proven experience in mathematical programming and algorithm development for process optimization.

• Advanced coding skills in Python, Julia, or R , with hands-on experience using optimization solvers.

• Solid understanding of supply chain fundamentals (planning, inventory management, scheduling) and manufacturing business processes.

Working knowledge of machine learning (regression, clustering, neural networks) and experience handling large-scale datasets.

Thanks

Aatmesh

title: Webflow Web Designer
description:

Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $1,500 USD


About Tecla

Tecla is recruitment and talent infrastructure for AI-forward companies. We place AI leaders, engineers, and specialists across the United States and Latin America, serving the technology teams at companies of every shape and size, from venture-backed startups to global enterprises. We have been recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies, hold a 4.8/5 rating on Trustpilot, and have served 500+ companies.


This role sits on our internal Growth team, working on our website (tecla.io). You will build and update landing pages, ship campaign assets, and improve site performance as our brand and offering keep evolving.


About the role

We are hiring a Webflow Web Designer to work alongside our lead Webflow designer. This is a real design role. Tecla has its own Webflow design system, and you will use that system to design and ship landing pages, blog pages, and other site work. We are not handing you pixel-perfect mockups to copy. You are designing the page, applying our system with taste and judgment, and bringing UX and UI chops to every layout you ship.


This role is also built for someone who lives in AI tools. We want a designer whose workflow is fundamentally AI-powered, not someone who occasionally pastes a prompt into ChatGPT. The pace of change in our industry is fast, and we want a teammate who is using AI to learn faster, build faster, and continuously raise the bar on what one designer can ship in a week.


You will be coached. You will grow fast. The ceiling is high if you bring real hunger, energy, and curiosity.


What you will do

  • Design and build landing pages, blog templates, and web assets in Webflow, working from our design system
  • Translate outlines from the content and performance teams into polished, high-performing pages
  • Improve site speed, responsiveness, and SEO hygiene across the site
  • Use AI tools across your workflow to move faster: prototyping, copy iteration, code, debugging, asset generation, QA, optimization
  • Collaborate closely with our lead Webflow designer, brand and creative, and the rest of the Growth team
  • Keep visual and UX consistency across the site
  • Stay on top of new tools and techniques and bring the best ones into how we work


What we are looking for

  • 1 to 2 years of hands-on Webflow experience. You can build pages from scratch, not just edit existing ones
  • Real UX and UI design skills. You can design a page, not just execute a mockup. You will be designing landing pages and blog pages using our existing design system, applying taste and judgment along the way
  • A real, demonstrable AI-powered workflow. You use AI tools daily and have opinions about which ones are worth the time. We will ask for specifics in the interview
  • Solid fundamentals in HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript
  • Fast, energetic, and naturally curious. You move quickly without being sloppy
  • Coachable. You take feedback well, apply it, and ask for more
  • Strong written and spoken English. You will be working closely with the team and with leadership


Nice to have

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Senior Backend Developer KYC (100% remote Worldwide)
description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.


Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.


Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?


About the job

As a senior Backend Developer, you will be a part of the team that works on the development and maintenance of the backend components of multiple services related to the platform. This includes:

  • New Products and Features - Tether continuously strives to create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional experience for customers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies, to ensure the user experience remains the best in the industry.
  • Scalability - all backend services that power Tether platform must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth.
  • Security - Tether makes Security its most important feature. The Backend Development team is responsible for building all the API services and backend processes with the highest security principles and standard, in order to protect the safety of the entire user base.


Responsibilities

  • Work closely with developers, product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to translate requirements into clear, practical architectures.
  • Improve existing core backend services written in NodeJS
  • Implement new solutions that interact with different core services through RPC calls
  • Write complex database queries for compliance and financial purposes


Requirements

  • At least 5 years of experience working with Javascript/Nodejs.
  • Familiar with microservices architecture
  • Have actively participated in the development of a complex platform
  • Good experience in interacting with databases (MySQL, MongoDB)
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies
  • Good understanding of security practices


Preferred skills

  • Experience with blockchain integration
  • Comfortable with high-availability concepts
  • Ruby and Rails experience
  • Other technologies of interest: Message queues (Redis), Caches and Job Queues


Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: Senior Studio Specialist
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Senior Studio Specialist at JoVE , you will drive the operational excellence of our in-house creative studio. You will execute and oversee project execution, optimize workflows, and introduce AI-powered solutions to enhance efficiency, quality, and scalability.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who understands the full creative production lifecycle and thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment - a love for science is a plus!


Responsibilities:

  • Oversee and coordinate the execution of creative projects from brief to final delivery
  • Maintain the studio production schedule and assign projects to the in-house motion graphics team based on availability, timelines, and project scope.
  • Track the day-to-day progress of projects in the pipeline, follow up on deadlines, flag delays, and ensure workload distribution supports on-time delivery.
  • Define and track KPIs, deadlines, and performance metrics to ensure smooth production cycles
  • Work closely with the Director of Marketing to translate business objectives into actionable creative plans
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to refine briefs and propose effective design solutions
  • Create and edit high-quality video assets to support marketing campaigns, product launches, digital initiatives, and brand awareness efforts.
  • Design, document, and continuously improve studio workflows and cross-functional processes
  • Ensure brand consistency and creative quality standards across all deliverables
  • Identify bottlenecks and implement scalable improvements to increase efficiency
  • Lead the integration of AI technologies into creative workflows, including automation, asset generation, project tracking, and quality optimization


Requirements:

  • 5–7 years of experience in creative production, studio coordination, or motion graphics environments
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent creative projects while ensuring quality and on-time delivery
  • Strong experience supporting and improving production workflows within creative teams
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate designers and balance workloads effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency with project management tools such as Asana (or similar platforms)
  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools to improve production efficiency and creative output
  • Strong attention to detail and quality control across all stages of the creative process
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders
  • Solid understanding of the end-to-end creative production lifecycle (briefing, design, review, revisions, final delivery)


Why Join JoVE?

  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Redator

Descrição da Empresa Clube Séries é uma comunidade apaixonada pelo universo dos seriados, dedicada a trazer informações atuais e relevantes sobre o mundo do entretenimento. Atuamos como uma plataforma colaborativa, conectando fãs de séries e criando conteúdo de alta qualidade para artigos, notícias e resenhas. Nosso objetivo é informar e entreter nosso público, promovendo discussões e reflexões sobre as novidades e tendências da televisão e do streaming. Nossa equipe valoriza a criatividade, a dedicação e a paixão pela escrita.

Descrição do Cargo O Redator de Notícias será responsável por escrever e publicar artigos informativos sobre o universo das séries, incluindo análises, comentários e comunicados de imprensa. As atividades diárias incluem pesquisa de temas relevantes, redação e revisão de textos e colaboração com outros membros da equipe para garantir o alinhamento com os objetivos editoriais. Este é um cargo voluntário com flexibilidade para trabalho remoto.

Qualificações

  • Redação de Notícias e Releases: Experiência em escrever notícias e comunicados de imprensa com clareza, concisão e precisão.
  • Habilidades de Comunicação: Capacidade de transmitir informações de forma eficaz por meio da escrita e colaborar com a equipe de forma clara e produtiva.
  • Jornalismo e Escrita: Conhecimento e prática em técnicas de jornalismo e habilidade para produzir conteúdo de qualidade que capte a atenção dos leitores.
  • Será um diferencial ter conhecimento em tendências de entretenimento e séries de TV, bem como habilidades em SEO para otimizar o alcance do conteúdo online.


Descrição da Empresa Clube Séries é uma plataforma dedicada aos apaixonados por séries de TV, trazendo conteúdos relevantes e diversificados sobre o universo dos seriados. description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Esta vaga atenderá nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do segmento de eletrodomésticos e soluções para o lar.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar no design, desenvolvimento e manutenção de sistemas backend escaláveis e de alta performance.
  • Desenvolver serviços utilizando Java 11+ e Spring Boot , aplicando boas práticas de arquitetura e engenharia de software.

  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de Front-end, DevOps, QA e Produto , garantindo entregas consistentes e de qualidade.
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de banco de dados SQL e NoSQL , otimizando consultas para alto volume e desempenho.
  • Garantir qualidade de código , cobertura de testes, segurança e aderência às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Atuar em CI/CD , contribuindo para pipelines de build, testes e deploy.

  • Participar de code reviews , discussões técnicas e definições arquiteturais.
  • Contribuir ativamente para a evolução técnica do produto e da plataforma.


O que você precisa ter

  • Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Forte experiência com Java (8/11+) , Spring Boot , Spring Data JPA e Spring Security .
  • Experiência prática com microsserviços e APIs REST .
  • Vivência com Docker , Kubernetes e ambientes de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP ).
  • Conhecimento sólido em bancos de dados como PostgreSQL, MySQL ou MongoDB .
  • Experiência com mensageria , como Kafka ou RabbitMQ .
  • Vivência com testes unitários e de integração , utilizando JUnit, Mockito ou frameworks similares.
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD , com ferramentas como Jenkins, GitHub Actions ou GitLab CI .
  • Forte capacidade de análise, resolução de problemas e depuração de sistemas complexos.

Será um destaque no seu perfil

No conforta da sua casa. Regime 100% home office.

title: Engenheiro(a) de IA (Generative AI & Agentic Systems)
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


Estamos expandindo nosso time de tecnologia e buscamos profissionais para atuar na fronteira da inteligência artificial aplicada aos setores financeiro e securitário. O foco será a construção de ecossistemas inteligentes, indo além de modelos isolados para criar arquiteturas de agentes capazes de resolver demandas complexas de negócio e backoffice.


O DESAFIO:


  • Orquestração e Agentes: Projetar sistemas multiagentes utilizando LangGraph ou Agent Squad para decompor tarefas complexas em workflows automatizados.
  • Observabilidade e Tracing (Prioridade): Implementar o rastreamento completo da \"cadeia de pensamento\" (Chain of Thought) e execução dos agentes.
  • Monitoramento de Performance: Utilizar ferramentas como Langfuse ou LangSmith para monitorar latência, consumo de tokens e qualidade das respostas em tempo real.
  • Desenvolvimento de Ferramentas: Criar conexões seguras entre LLMs e APIs externas via Model Context Protocol (MCP) , garantindo o isolamento e a segurança dos dados.
  • Arquitetura RAG: Otimizar pipelines de recuperação de informação utilizando Vector Stores (Pinecone ou MongoDB ) para mitigar alucinações e aumentar a precisão contextual.
  • Infraestrutura Cloud: Gerenciar deploys em ambientes AWS ou Azure e integrar modelos via AWS Bedrock ou Azure OpenAI Service , priorizando arquiteturas Serverless e Event-Driven.
  • AI Guardrails: Implementar camadas de filtragem e validação de prompts/outputs para evitar injeções de código ou desvios éticos.
  • Avaliação Sistemática: Desenvolver frameworks de testes (Evals) para validar a eficácia de novas funcionalidades antes do deploy em produção.
  • Eficiência de Custos: Monitorar e otimizar o uso de modelos (Model Routing) para equilibrar performance e custo operacional.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:


  • Linguagens: Domínio avançado de Python e Java para automação de workflows e integraçoes e desenvolvimento de IA.
  • DevOps/MLOps: Experiência com Docker , Containerization e práticas de CI/CD para modelos de linguagem.
  • Educação: Graduação em Engenharia de Computação ou áreas correlatas.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:


  • Experiência prévia na construção de assistentes inteligentes escaláveis (ex: via WhatsApp) e pesquisa em Explainable AI (XAI) .



O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ

Assistência Médica

title: ZScaler Engineer
description:
We are seeking a ZTNA Operations Support Engineer to join our Network Security Operations team. This role is primarily focused on the day-to-day operation, monitoring, and support of Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) services.


You will be responsible for ensuring reliable and secure user access, handling incidents, and maintaining operational excellence across our Zero Trust environment. This position is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience in support, troubleshooting, and service operations within secure access platforms (ZTNA, VPN, or SSE) using Zscaler.


Key Responsibilities


- Provide L3 operational support for the ZTNA platform.

- Handle incident, request, and problem management through ticketing systems.

- Troubleshoot and resolve:

 - User access and connectivity issues

 - Authentication and SSO-related problems

 - Application access failures and latency complaints

- Perform initial triage, impact assessment, and escalation when required.

- Monitor platform health, alerts, and dashboards to ensure service availability.

- Execute standard operational changes (policy updates, user onboarding/offboarding, access adjustments).

- Maintain and follow runbooks, SOPs, and escalation procedures.

- Support major incident management (MIM) and post-incident reviews (RCA support).

- Work closely with engineering teams for issue handoff and permanent fixes.

- Contribute to continuous service improvement and operational efficiency.


Required Qualifications


- Experience in network/security operations or technical support roles.

- Hands-on experience with ZTNA, VPN, or remote access solutions.

- Familiarity with at least one major vendor platform (Zscaler, preferred, but not exclusively).

- Strong understanding of:

 - TCP/IP, DNS, and basic network troubleshooting

 - Authentication flows (SSO, MFA, SAML, OIDC)

- Experience working with ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira).

- Ability to analyze logs and identify root causes of common issues.


Preferred Qualifications


- Experience in Security Operations Center (SOC) or Network Operations Center (NOC) environments.

- Exposure to SSE/SASE environments.

- Familiarity with endpoint posture, device compliance, and access policies.

- Experience supporting large-scale enterprise environments.


Soft Skills


- Strong customer support mindset with clear communication skills.

- Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tickets under SLA pressure.

- Detail-oriented with strong documentation habits.

- Team player with a proactive approach to operational stability.

description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Job Overview:

We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals.
  • Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance.


Domain Tracks:

You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g; expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus.

  • Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems.
  • Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design.
  • Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry.
  • Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification.
  • Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design.
  • Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference.
  • Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads.
  • Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design.
  • Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design.
  • Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration.
  • Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis).
  • Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain.
  • Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills.
  • High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism.

title: Travel Consultant and Sales Manager
description:
About Us

Dehouche is a leading provider of luxury tailor-made travel to South America, specialising in unforgettable journeys for a discerning clientele. From custom-built wilderness camps to luxury city hotel buyouts and \"money can't buy\" experiences, we pride ourselves on exceptional service and creating memories that last a lifetime.

The Opportunity

We're growing our Rio de Janeiro team and hiring for two positions:

  • Travel Consultant - a senior sales role focused on converting enquiries into bookings and building lasting client relationships.
  • Sales Manager - a senior consultant who also leads, develops, and drives the performance of our consultant team.

Both roles share the same DNA: a highly personalised, authentic approach to selling, and a natural talent for understanding and anticipating client needs. If you're motivated by clients thanking you for the trip of a lifetime, we want to hear from you.

Travel Consultant - What You'll Do

  • Convert enquiries into confirmed bookings by crafting bespoke itineraries that genuinely excite clients.
  • Consult with clients to uncover their aspirations, budget, and motivations, and translate those into compelling proposals.
  • Pitch and close confidently, handling objections and guiding clients to a decision.
  • Build trusted, long-term relationships that drive repeat business and referrals.
  • Negotiate rates and added value with suppliers to keep our product competitively priced without compromising quality.
  • Stay ahead of the curve on destination developments, new openings, and emerging experiences across the region.

Sales Manager - What You'll Do

In addition to everything above, you'll:

  • Lead and develop our team of travel consultants, coaching on consultative selling, proposal craft, and closing.
  • Own the team's pipeline and forecast: track conversion, identify bottlenecks, and intervene early.
  • Set, review, and drive individual and team revenue targets.
  • Act as a senior point of escalation on complex or high-value enquiries.
  • Partner with leadership on commercial strategy, pricing, and supplier negotiations.
  • Help recruit, onboard, and shape the next generation of our team.

What We're Looking For (Both Roles)

You're a seasoned travel sales professional with a strong track record of selling high-value travel and consistently hitting, and exceeding, revenue targets. You know how to move a client from \"interested\" to \"booked\".

You're a natural closer. Confident pitching, comfortable talking about price, and able to create urgency without ever feeling pushy.

You have your finger on the pulse of South America: what's new, what's exciting, what clients can't find anywhere else.

You're commercially minded. You understand margin, negotiate well with suppliers, and price trips competitively while maintaining the level of luxury synonymous with our brand.

Your attention to detail is excellent. The trips you sell are executed flawlessly, and your written correspondence is consistently polished.

You're a team player. You share ideas freely and build strong relationships with clients, guides, and colleagues alike.

Additionally for the Sales Manager

  • Demonstrable experience leading or mentoring a sales team, with examples of how you've lifted individual or team performance.
  • Comfortable with numbers: pipeline reporting, forecasting, and conversion analysis.
  • The judgement to know when to coach, when to step in, and when to let your team run.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Demonstrable experience in travel sales, with a track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
  • Knowledge of South America as a destination is essential. Latin America and the Caribbean a plus.
  • Native-level English. Portuguese, Spanish, or other languages a plus.
  • Excellent communication, listening, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
  • Resilient, self-motivated, and genuinely passionate about travel.
  • Based in, or willing to relocate to, Rio de Janeiro.

How to Apply

Email your CV, along with a short note telling us which role you're applying for and why, to .
