title: Designer Gráfico Freelancer (PJ) | Diagramação de Materiais Corporativos
description:
Designer Gráfico Freelancer (PJ) | Diagramação de Materiais Corporativos

Remoto | Projeto estruturado | Início imediato


A Dream Success busca prestador de serviço (PJ/freelancer) para execução de Projeto de Diagramação Temporário. Com foco na estruturação de materiais de consultoria com padrão corporativo, via CanvaPro e Pacote Adobe.


Este não é um projeto de criação livre e sim de execução operacional. Buscamos profissionais (ou empresas) com capacidade comprovada de execução técnica, padronização e produção em escala.



Escopo da Prestação de Serviço

  • Diagramação de material principal (~300 páginas);
  • Aplicação rigorosa do brand kit;
  • Organização visual de conteúdo previamente estruturado;
  • Desenvolvimento de materiais complementares, como Canva Packs (nível profissional, do zero), Propostas gráficas e Materiais vinculados ao conteúdo principal;
  • O foco está em materiais com padrão corporativo, não sendo o objetivo estilos ilustrativos, autorais ou caricatos.



Requisitos Técnicos (Obrigatórios)

  • Domínio avançado real de Canva Pro;
  • Domínio do Pacote Adobe (uso profissional);
  • Experiência comprovada em diagramação de books, relatórios ou materiais corporativos extensos;
  • Estruturação visual com foco em leitura e hierarquia de informação;
  • Capacidade de desenvolver Canva Packs do zero (não adaptados).


É obrigatório que o prestador possua licenças ativas e próprias das ferramentas (Canva Pro e Adobe).



Modelo de Prestação de Serviço

  • Contratação como pessoa jurídica (PJ) / freelancer;
  • Remuneração por hora efetivamente trabalhada - R$ 16,25 por hora com referência de até R$ 650 semanais;
  • A execução das horas ocorre com autonomia de organização, sem exigência de horário fixo, com expectativa de disponibilidade de até 40 horas semanais dedicadas ao projeto;
  • Durante o período de execução das horas registradas, é esperado foco integral na prestação do serviço. Não sendo compatível a execução simultânea de outras atividades durante o período registrado;
  • A Dream Success disponibiliza ao prestador a ferramenta de acompanhamento de produtividade (Jibble), que realiza registro de horas trabalhadas e monitoramento da atividade remota durante o período de execução.


Ao se candidatar, o prestador declara estar ciente e de acordo com:

  • O uso da ferramenta durante a prestação do serviço;
  • O monitoramento integral das horas registradas;
  • As diretrizes aplicáveis de proteção de dados (LGPD).



Fluxo de Avaliação

Nosso processo de avaliação é estruturado para garantir, de forma objetiva, a validação da capacidade técnica e da aderência ao tipo de entrega exigida pelo projeto. As etapas abaixo seguem uma lógica sequencial de profundidade, iniciando pela análise prática e avançando para validação de contexto e execução.


  • Envio obrigatório de portfólio em PDF: O portfólio deve ser anexado diretamente na candidatura via LinkedIn e precisa conter, obrigatoriamente, materiais alinhados ao escopo do projeto, como books, relatórios, apresentações estruturadas ou documentos corporativos extensos. Portfólios com foco em peças criativas, redes sociais ou materiais desalinhados ao contexto não serão considerados.Candidaturas sem portfólio no formato solicitado serão desclassificadas automaticamente.
  • Vídeo de apresentação: Após a triagem inicial, os profissionais selecionados serão convidados a gravar um vídeo de apresentação. O objetivo desta etapa é aprofundar o entendimento sobre sua experiência prática, validar sua participação real nos projetos apresentados e esclarecer eventuais pontos do portfólio.
  • Entrevista com o gestor do projeto: Etapa focada na validação técnica mais aprofundada e no alinhamento sobre padrão de entrega, dinâmica de execução e expectativa de performance dentro do projeto.
  • Início imediato: Profissionais aprovados seguem para início imediato da prestação de serviço.



Perfil Esperado

Este projeto exige um perfil de atuação específico, com foco em execução estruturada e previsível. Abaixo estão os principais comportamentos e competências esperadas para uma boa performance nesse contexto:


  • Organização e método de trabalho: Capacidade de operar com estrutura, lógica e padronização ao longo de todo o material.
  • Disciplina em projetos extensos: Manter consistência visual e qualidade ao longo de grande volume de páginas.
  • Precisão na aplicação de diretrizes: Seguir brand kit e orientações com rigor, sem desvios de padrão.
  • Foco em execução e entrega: Capacidade de transformar conteúdo estruturado em material visual claro, funcional e consistente.



Importante

Antes de avançar, é importante deixar claro o tipo de perfil que não tende a performar bem neste projeto . Os pontos abaixo existem para evitar desalinhamento de expectativa durante a execução:


  • Perfil criativo/autoral como foco principal: Este projeto não prioriza liberdade criativa, e sim execução dentro de padrão definido.
  • Ausência de experiência com materiais corporativos: A falta de vivência com esse tipo de entrega impacta diretamente na qualidade esperada.
  • Domínio superficial das ferramentas exigidas: É necessário uso prático e avançado de Canva Pro e Pacote Adobe.
  • Dificuldade em manter constância produtiva: Projetos extensos exigem ritmo, organização e continuidade.



Direcionamento Final

Se você busca participar de projetos estruturados, com alto nível de exigência e impacto real na entrega ao cliente, essa é uma oportunidade para atuar com profundidade e consistência em um material relevante.


Do nosso lado, garantimos um processo de avaliação ágil e respeitoso com seu tempo. Desde já, agradecemos sua atenção e interesse

title: Analista Financeiro de Orçamento Pleno
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Elaboração e divulgação de relatórios com análise de resultados mensais acompanhando o real x orçado das unidades de negócios/shoppings e departamentos;
  • Apoiar a elaborar relatórios gerenciais e apresentações;
  • Participar da construção do orçamento anual (Budget) e projeções periódicas (Forecast);
  • Apoiar e participar do acompanhamento do resultado operacional (NOI), assegurando aderência ao orçamento aprovado e a avaliação de distorções;
  • Atuar com perfil analítico, visão crítica e atenção a detalhes elaborando análises financeiras, identificando variações, causas dos desvios e propondo ações corretivas quando aplicável;
  • Manter relacionamento contínuo com as diversas áreas da companhia, atuando de forma colaborativa, com postura proativa e orientação a resultados;
  • Contribuir para a melhoria dos controles internos, por meio da revisão de processos e implementação de automatizações, com foco na eficiência operacional e na governança dos dados.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Excel avançado e conhecimento em Power BI ou ferramentas de visualização de dados serão um diferencial;
  • Perfil analítico, proativo e com boa capacidade de comunicação.

title: Server Manager (Global Project) [Inglês Avançado]
description:
Estamos em busca de um Server Manager altamente qualificado para integrar nossa equipe de Enhanced Operation Service (EOS), que faz parte da organização de Enterprise Cloud Services Delivery. Neste papel, você atuará como um consultor de confiança, sendo responsável por salvaguardar e otimizar a entrega de ponta a ponta para clientes estratégicos durante sua jornada de transformação em nuvem.

Você fará parte de um projeto global , integrando um time que atua em uma operação 24x7 para um cliente da Tech Mahindra. Esta é uma posição remota, com alocação mínima prevista de um ano. O horário inicial será de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, porém a escala é passível de alteração ao longo do projeto para atender às necessidades operacionais.


Principais Responsabilidades

Seu trabalho envolverá uma carga de trabalho mista, com foco em manter a estabilidade e a performance do sistema:

  • Gestão de Incidentes e Problemas: Participar ativamente no tratamento de incidentes críticos (Major Incidents), solucionar falhas em solicitações de serviço e realizar análise de causa raiz (RCA) para interrupções ou problemas de desempenho.
  • Solicitações de Serviço e Mudança: Executar solicitações de serviço e mudanças complexas, gerenciando extensões de tempo de inatividade e incidentes de longa duração.
  • Otimização de Performance: Identificar e liderar iniciativas proativas para melhorar a operação, estabilidade e padronização dos sistemas dos clientes.
  • Suporte Técnico Especializado: Fornecer suporte técnico especializado em Linux e infraestrutura, com foco em solução de problemas de disco, servidor e conectividade de rede.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Otimizar procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) por meio de automação e definir planos de ação corretiva para atingir os KPIs estabelecidos.
  • Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua.


Requisitos Técnicos Centrais

  • Expertise em Linux (Obrigatório): Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu . É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema.
  • Clustering & HA (Obrigatório - Flexível): Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em configurações de Alta Disponibilidade (HA). Conhecimento em Pacemaker é preferencial, mas outras ferramentas de clustering (como Red Hat HA) são aceitáveis.
  • Proficiência em Nuvem (Obrigatório): Experiência prática em pelo menos um dos principais provedores de nuvem pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP . Experiência em ambientes multi-cloud será considerada um diferencial.
  • Redes: Capacidade avançada para diagnosticar problemas de rede em ambiente Linux e nuvem, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP, NAT, firewalls e análise de conectividade.
  • Automação: Experiência com linguagens de script (Shell, Python, Go, etc.) e ferramentas de automação de servidores como Ansible ou CHEF .


Qualificações e Experiência

  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área de infraestrutura de TI e operações de servidores.
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Gestão de TI ou áreas correlatas.
  • Idioma: Inglês Fluente é imprescindível, dado que toda a interação com o time global, documentação e suporte ao cliente será realizada em inglês.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Foco no cliente, pensamento analítico orientado a soluções e capacidade de adquirir novos conhecimentos de forma independente e proativa.


Imporante:

Inglês é Mandatório.

title: Técnico de Suporte I
description:
Somos o Grupo SADA! Um grupo referência em transporte e logística, além de atuação em diversos segmentos de negócios movidos por milhares de pessoas dispostas a darem o seu melhor, todos os dias. Somos serviços, informação, indústria, concessionárias, energia limpa, esporte e responsabilidade social movimentando a vida das pessoas há mais de 45 anos, e é isso que nos faz ir mais longe.


Venha para uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil. Uma empresa que cuida das pessoas e se preocupa em proporcionar um ambiente de trabalho cada vez mais saudável e seguro, pois queremos que nossos colaboradores sempre sintam orgulho de trabalhar aqui.

Somos plurais por natureza, um grupo diverso em negócios e pessoas. Acreditamos que as diferenças somam e movimentam, e é por isso que o Grupo SADA quer conhecer você. Todas as nossas vagas são extensivas as Pessoas com Deficiência e profissionais reabilitados do INSS. Quem sabe alguma oportunidade combina com você.


Resumo da Posição:


Atuar na avaliação e tratamento de chamados relacionados ao time de Serviços e Service Desk, assegurando a resolução eficiente de incidentes e requisições. O profissional será responsável por fortalecer a governança, controle e gestão dos ativos de TI, garantindo conformidade, rastreabilidade e eficiência operacional.


Oportunidade: Técnico de Suporte I

Local: Porto Real - Rio de Janeiro

Modelo de Trabalho: 100% Presencial


Principais responsabilidades:


• Avaliar demandas e conduzir tratativas conforme os processos do Grupo SADA;

• Prestar suporte técnico a usuários (hardware, software, redes e sistemas corporativos);

• Gerenciar ativos de TI (ITAM), incluindo:

  • Controle de inventário (notebooks, desktops e periféricos);
  • Movimentação, alocação e baixa de ativos;
  • Atualização de base de ativos (CMDB e/ou planilhas);
  • Apoio em processos de onboarding e offboarding;
  • Garantia de conformidade com políticas de segurança da informação;
  • Acompanhamento do ciclo de vida dos ativos (aquisição ao descarte);

• Apoiar auditorias internas e externas relacionadas a ativos de TI;

• Interagir com fornecedores para manutenção e aquisição de equipamentos;

• Criar e manter documentações e procedimentos operacionais; e

• Apoiar na padronização de imagens e configurações de máquinas.


REQUISITOS NECESSÁRIOS:


• Conhecimento em sistemas operacionais Windows;

• Experiência com ferramentas de Service Desk;

• Noções de redes (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP);

• Conhecimento ou experiência em gestão de ativos de TI (ITAM);

• Conhecimento no Pacote Office; e

• Noções básicas de segurança da informação.


REQUISITOS DIFERENCIAIS (DESEJÁVEIS):


• Experiência com CMDB

• Conhecimento em ITIL

• Vivência em ambientes corporativos estruturados

• Certificações na área (ITIL, Microsoft, entre outras)


Por que fazer parte do Grupo SADA?


No Grupo SADA, acreditamos que a tecnologia é um pilar essencial para conectar pessoas, processos e resultados. Mais do que suporte, ela é um elemento estratégico para garantir eficiência, continuidade operacional e uma experiência consistente para nossos usuários.


Como Técnico de Suporte I, você fará parte de um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e orientado à excelência, onde sua capacidade de análise, organização e resolução de problemas terá impacto direto na operação e na governança dos recursos tecnológicos da companhia.


Buscamos profissionais que valorizem a qualidade no atendimento, a disciplina nos processos e a melhoria contínua, contribuindo ativamente para a gestão eficiente dos ativos de TI e para a evolução dos nossos serviços.


Se você deseja atuar em um ambiente estruturado, com foco em resultados, conformidade e inovação, e quer construir uma trajetória sólida em tecnologia, o Grupo SADA é o lugar certo para o seu desenvolvimento profissional.


Venha fazer parte dessa história!

Candidate-se e contribua para fortalecer a marca e a cultura do Grupo SADA.


NOSSA HISTÓRIA

Para contar a história do nosso grupo empresarial precisamos voltar ao Brasil dos anos 70, quando um jovem visionário desembarcava da Europa trazendo objetivos bem audaciosos. Ali, iniciava a trajetória da SADA, com a implantação de uma pequena transportadora na região metropolitana de Belo Horizonte.


Fundada em 4 de agosto de 1976, na cidade de Contagem, em Minas Gerais, a SADA Transportes e Armazéns S/A é criada, a partir da necessidade de atender as demandas de armazenagem e distribuição automobilística no país.


Sete anos depois, em 1983, a empresa é transferida para Betim em um terreno de cerca de 31 mil metros quadrados, 23 vezes menor que a área ocupada pela empresa atualmente. “Ainda muito jovem, cheguei aqui vindo da Itália com a tarefa de montar a SADA no Brasil junto com a chegada da Fiat”, conta Vittorio Medioli, fundador presidente do Grupo SADA.


Assim como seu precursor, a origem do nome SADA também é italiana.

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.


Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form . After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment , which must be completed within 24 hours . Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Senior OutSystems Engineer
description:
Senior OutSystems Engineer


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior OutSystems Engineer to lead platform stabilization and migration readiness efforts for a large-scale clinical application supporting 130+ locations nationwide. This is a highly hands-on, high-impact role focused on improving system performance, reducing risk, and preparing the platform for an eventual transition to a custom-built solution.


This engagement is expected to begin late April or early May and run approximately 6 weeks, with strong potential for extension based on performance.


What You’ll Do

Stabilize and Modernize Architecture

Assess tightly coupled module architecture and reduce dependencies

Identify and execute module extraction strategies to improve scalability

Minimize risk and blast radius of ongoing changes without disrupting workflows

Optimize Database and System Performance

Improve database performance by optimizing queries and implementing indexing strategies

Design and execute migration of binary large objects out of the database

Replace inefficient polling with event-driven or conditional patterns

Implement backpressure controls for integrations impacting system performance

Reduce Error Noise and Improve Observability

Identify and remediate recurring error patterns masking real issues

Refactor exception handling and client-side lifecycle violations

Establish a clean, monitorable baseline for system health

Build a Real Release Pipeline

Establish a true multi-environment deployment pipeline

Configure deployment automation using OutSystems APIs

Implement gated release processes with approvals and controls

Ensure non-production environments support meaningful regression testing

Manage Platform Capacity and Licensing

Audit platform usage and identify optimization opportunities

Remove unused or redundant components

Define governance for capacity-impacting changes

Extend platform headroom without impacting functionality

Prepare for Migration to Custom Platform

Document all integrations including triggers, data contracts, and failure modes

Map data entities into portable schemas

Capture business logic embedded within the platform

Identify core business logic vs platform-generated components

Advise on migration sequencing and risk across workflows


What You Bring

Required Experience

5+ years building and maintaining enterprise-scale OutSystems applications

Deep experience with OutSystems 11, Service Studio, and Lifetime API

Proven success optimizing performance including query tuning and data model improvements

Experience refactoring complex, tightly coupled systems into modular architectures

Strong SQL Server performance tuning experience including execution plans and indexing

Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation within OutSystems

Strong problem-solving skills in live production environments

Preferred Experience

Experience supporting or leading OutSystems to custom platform migrations

Background in healthcare or clinical systems with understanding of critical workflows

Familiarity with HIPAA considerations and secure data handling

Experience with license optimization and application object management

Knowledge of integration patterns across scheduling, e-signature, or CRM systems

Working Environment

Collaborate closely with internal engineering and PM leadership

Operate with high autonomy and ownership of technical decisions

Work within a live production environment supporting critical clinical operations

Balance speed and precision while minimizing risk to end users


This is a unique opportunity to step into a complex, high-visibility system, make immediate impact, and shape the foundation for a next-generation platform.

title: Forensic Manager

Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are looking for a SwarmBench Task Engineer specializing in planning and operations to design and build complex, multi-agent benchmark tasks that simulate real-world planning, scheduling, and operational decision-making scenarios. This role focuses on creating constraint-rich problems that evaluate multi-agent reasoning, decomposition, and optimization capabilities in realistic environments.


What does day-to-day life look like?

  • Design and develop multi-agent benchmark tasks involving:
  • Planning, scheduling, and resource allocation
  • Operational decision-making (project management, logistics, incident response, capacity planning)
  • Create constraint-rich problem statements with multiple interacting variables
  • Develop verification scripts to evaluate:
  • Feasibility (all constraints satisfied)
  • Completeness (all requirements addressed)
  • Optimality (efficient solutions)
  • Build decomposition strategies:
  • Split tasks across specialized sub-agents (resource-based, constraint-based, conflict resolution, optimization)
  • Model real-world operational scenarios with dependencies, timelines, and resource constraints
  • Collaborate on improving task quality, coverage, and evaluation rigor


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in operations, project management, logistics, or supply chain
  • Strong ability to formalize constraints, dependencies, and scheduling logic
  • Proficiency in Python for building verification and validation scripts
  • Strong structured problem-solving and decomposition skills
  • Clear and precise technical writing skills
  • Experience with AI coding benchmarks (e.g., SWE-bench, Terminal-bench)
  • Hands-on experience with Docker (Dockerfiles, image builds, debugging)


Nice to have:

  • Experience with optimization techniques (linear programming, constraint satisfaction, scheduling algorithms)
  • Background in operations research
  • Experience with simulation or modeling tools
  • Knowledge of AI planning systems or automated reasoning
  • Project management experience or certifications (PMP, Agile, etc.)

  • Excellent observational and visual interpretation skills
  • Clear and concise written communication

title: Direct-Response Creative Strategist
description:
About us

Clickbait Agency is a YouTube ad creative and media buying agency. We only work with 8 and 9-figure DTC brands and our focus is simple, producing video creatives that scale profitably on YouTube and this means that you’ll be working directly on accounts most agencies don’t get near.

We care deeply about being the best at what we do which means fast iteration, high standards, and creatives that spend millions. We’ve built proprietary AI systems that support our creative and production workflows, and our video production runs through a dedicated team of AI prompters, so strategists can stay focused on strategy.

We think YouTube creative is going through a significant shift right now and we’re positioning ourselves at the front of it.


The role

We’re looking for a creative strategist who understands direct response at a serious level and can develop and script YouTube ads and mini VSLs for competitive ecommerce markets.

You’ll be responsible for research, angle development, hook writing, scripting, and iterating based on performance data. Your scripts go through our AI production team, so the output is fast and the feedback loop is short.

You’ll be working across multiple 8 and 9-figure brands simultaneously. The work is demanding and the bar is high.


What we’re looking for

We’re only looking for people who are genuinely good at this. If you’re earlier in your career or still developing your DR fundamentals, this isn’t the right fit yet.

You should have:

  • 2+ years writing direct response video ads for YouTube or Facebook
  • A real understanding of Eugene Schwartz’s awareness stages and how to apply them to cold traffic
  • Experience scripting hooks, mini VSLs, and full ad concepts
  • The ability to look at performance data and use it to build the next creative
  • Proven spend behind your work — creatives you’ve written that have run profitably at scale
  • Comfort using AI tools as part of your day-to-day workflow

Experience in compliance-sensitive categories like supplements or weight loss is a bonus. So is familiarity with unique mechanism development and RMBC.


What we offer

Base salary with a performance bonus tied to winning creatives. When your work scales, your compensation reflects that.

You’ll have access to proprietary AI tools built specifically for our workflow, a production team that handles execution, and a team around you that takes the work seriously.

This is a fully remote position.


One thing worth knowing

There’s a short test task as part of the application process. It’s there to see how you think, not to take your time for nothing.

title: Senior Web Developer
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a Modern Web Developer to design, build, and ship high-quality websites across our agency group — primarily in WordPress and HubSpot, but increasingly using AI-native build tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor.


This is not a classic WordPress role buried in PHP. We need someone who is technically broad and modern: comfortable in a CMS, fluent in modern JavaScript and APIs, and excited to use AI coding tools to ship faster than a traditional dev shop. You'll build marketing sites, landing pages, and lightweight web apps — and just as often, wire those sites into the rest of our stack via APIs, webhooks, and automations.


If you love shipping polished, conversion-ready sites and you're allergic to bloated,

brittle WordPress builds, you'll fit right in.


Key Responsibilities

Website Development

  • Design and build production-grade marketing websites in WordPress (custom themes/blocks, ACF, headless setups where appropriate) and HubSpot CMS (HubL templating, modules, themes).
  • Use Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI-native tools to accelerate
  • prototyping and full builds — for client work and internal tools alike.
  • Build clean, performant, accessible front-end experiences (semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JS or framework-as-needed).
  • Maintain and extend existing client sites: new pages, modules, redesigns, performance tuning, and migrations.


API Integrations & Automation Hooks

  • Integrate websites with HubSpot, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, analytics tools, and custom APIs.
  • Wire up form submissions, gated content, and lead routing to webhooks, n8n flows, and serverless functions.
  • Build lightweight internal tools, microsites, and utilities when a full CMS is overkill (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, etc.).


Quality, Performance & SEO

  • Own Core Web Vitals, page speed, schema markup, and on-page technical SEO basics for every site you ship.
  • Implement analytics and tracking correctly (GA4, GTM, HubSpot tracking, server-side events where needed).
  • Test thoroughly across devices and browsers; care about the details.


Collaboration

  • Work directly with designers, strategists, and marketers to translate Figma into pixel-faithful, on-brand builds.
  • Participate in code reviews, version control workflows (Git/GitHub), and documentation.
  • Help define internal standards for how we build sites across the agency group going forward.


Required Skills

Technical

  • 3+ years building production websites in WordPress (custom themes, blocks, ACF, plugin selection and customization).
  • Strong HubSpot CMS experience (HubL, modules, themes, forms, smart content).
  • Proficient in HTML, CSS, JavaScript — comfortable with modern tooling, build steps, and at least one JS framework when needed (React/Next.js a plus).
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or equivalent) — and a clear point of view on when to use them vs. when to write code yourself.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and serverless functions.
  • Comfortable in Git/GitHub with branching, PRs, and basic CI/CD.


Modern Web Skills

  • Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies).
  • Technical SEO fundamentals (schema, sitemaps, redirects, canonical handling).
  • Accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation).
  • Analytics and tag management (GA4, GTM, server-side tracking).


Bonus Experience

(Not required, but highly valuable)

  • Webflow development experience.
  • Headless WordPress or HubSpot setups (Next.js + WP/HubSpot APIs).
  • Experience with Supabase, Postgres, or Firebase for lightweight app backends.
  • Familiarity with n8n, Make.com, or Zapier for stitching sites into broader workflows.
  • E-commerce experience (WooCommerce, Shopify).
  • Design sensibility — you can read a Figma file and notice when something is off without being told.


Soft Skills

  • Bias toward shipping. You'd rather get a working v1 live than debate architecture for two weeks.
  • Detail-oriented — you care about pixel alignment, spacing, and typography as much as the underlying code.
  • Strong communicator with non-technical teammates; you can explain trade-offs to a strategist or account lead without jargon.
  • Curious about new tools and models — you experiment on your own time and bring ideas back to the team.
  • Comfortable juggling multiple sites and clients in a fast-moving agency environment.


What Success Looks Like

  • In the first 60–90 days, you will:
  • Ship at least 2–3 client websites or major redesigns end-to-end.
  • Establish standards for how we use AI coding tools across web builds (when to reach for Lovable, when to drop into Claude Code, when to write it ourselves).
  • Integrate at least one site deeply with our automation stack (HubSpot, n8n, custom APIs) in a way that becomes a reusable pattern.
  • Become the internal go-to person for technical web questions across the agency group.

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with demonstrated experience in coordinating and supporting investment-oriented development initiatives aligned with EU Global Gatewa y priorities. The objective is to strengthen local and regional expert networks and increase awareness, coordination capacity, and project preparation support for Global Gateway-related investments and reforms.

Experts may be engaged for short- and long-term assignments under EU-funded technical assistance projects, Team Europe initiatives, and donor-financed infrastructure and investment programmes.


Areas of Expertise

We are particularly interested in experts with experience in one or more of the following sectors:

  • Sustainable infrastructure
  • Energy and renewable energy
  • Digital transformation and connectivity
  • Transport infrastructure and mobility
  • Water, sanitation, and environmental management
  • Private sector development and investment promotion
  • Climate resilience and green transition
  • Public sector reforms linked to investment and infrastructure development


Key Responsibilities

Selected experts may support activities such as:

  • Contributing to the development and implementation of reform strategies and policy actions
  • Supporting coordination across EU Global Gateway priority sectors and stakeholders
  • Assisting in the identification and preparation of investment projects aligned with Global Gateway priorities
  • Conducting or contributing to regulatory , institutional , and sector analyses
  • Supporting feasibility preparation and investment pipeline development
  • Facilitating coordination between partner-country institutions, IFIs, Team Europe actors, private sector stakeholders, and development partners
  • Supporting stakeholder engagement, dialogue facilitation, and institutional coordination processes
  • Contributing to donor coordination and alignment with EU external cooperation priorities


Requirements

Candidates should demonstrate:

  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience in development cooperation , infrastructure , investment , or related sectors
  • Proven experience in EU-funded external cooperation programmes
  • Experience in project preparation and/or coordination under the EU Global Gateway framework, Team Europe initiatives, or similar investment-oriented international development programmes
  • Experience working with partner-country institutions , international financial institutions (IFIs) , development finance institutions , or private sector stakeholders
  • Strong analytical, coordination, and stakeholder engagement skills
  • Excellent communication and reporting abilities


Language Requirements

  • English proficiency at minimum C1 level is mandatory
  • Additional languages relevant to partner countries are considered an asset


Please note that inclusion in the expert pool does not guarantee immediate assignment. Experts will be contacted based on project requirements and matching qualifications. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack — Inteligência Artificial (Pleno/Sênior)
description:
Sobre a Stratesys

A Stratesys é uma consultoria multinacional especializada em transformação digital e soluções tecnológicas, com presença consolidada na Europa e nas Américas.   • indexação e estruturação de documentos;
  • geração de embeddings e vetorização;
  • recuperação, orquestração de prompts e contextualização de respostas.
  • Construir APIs back‑end escaláveis (REST e/ou GraphQL) para comunicação entre bots, serviços e sistemas externos.

  • Participar ativamente de sprints ágeis , refinamentos, revisões e decisões técnicas; prototipar novas funcionalidades com IA generativa e automação.
  • Documentar arquitetura, fluxos e integrações de forma clara para o time técnico e stakeholders.

  • 5+ anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Forte experiência com NestJS e arquitetura modular.
  • Experiência sólida em APIs REST e/ou GraphQL .

  • Experiência comprovável com RAG : embeddings/vetorização, conexão a bases documentais e orquestração de prompts.

  • Proficiência em JavaScript/TypeScript , além de HTML e CSS .
  • Experiência com bases de dados relacionais e/ou NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis).
  • Integrações via Webhooks , OAuth2 , JWT e APIs corporativas .
  • Conhecimentos de segurança e performance aplicados ao desenvolvimento.
  • Experiência com cloud computing (AWS , Azure ou GCP ) para deploy e escalabilidade.
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).


Diferenciais


  • Conhecimentos em DevOps e práticas de CI/CD .
  • Experiência com Docker , Kubernetes e automação de deploys.
  • Familiaridade com MLOps ou pipelines de dados.
  • Segurança da Informação aplicada a soluções com LLMs .

title: Mechanical Supervisor
description:
Location: Dalian, China (initial phase) | Brazil Offshore (subsequent operations)

Rights to Work: Brazil

Employment Type: Contractor / Rotational


Role Description

We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Supervisor to join a major offshore oil and gas project, initially based at a shipyard in Dalian, China during the construction and pre-commissioning phase, before mobilising to Brazil for offshore operations. The successful candidate will play a critical role in overseeing mechanical installation, inspection, and commissioning activities, ensuring compliance with project specifications, international standards, and client requirements.


Construction & Commissioning Phase (Dalian, China)

  • Supervise and coordinate all mechanical installation activities at the shipyard, including rotating equipment, static equipment, piping systems, and structural mechanical components
  • Review and interpret engineering drawings, P&IDs, isometrics, and equipment data sheets
  • Monitor contractor and vendor progress against project schedules, flagging deviations and driving corrective actions
  • Conduct daily site walks and formal inspections, ensuring work is executed in accordance with approved procedures and specifications
  • Attend and participate in FAT (Factory Acceptance Tests) and SAT (Site Acceptance Tests) for mechanical equipment
  • Interface with QA/QC teams to ensure all mechanical work packages are correctly documented, punch-listed, and closed out
  • Liaise with engineering, procurement, and construction teams to resolve technical queries and NCRs (Non-Conformance Reports) in a timely manner
  • Support Pre-Commissioning and Commissioning activities in preparation for sail-away


Offshore Operations Phase (Brazil)

  • Supervise mechanical maintenance and operational activities in accordance with the approved maintenance management system
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements (ANP, IBAMA) and applicable international standards (API, ASME, ISO)
  • Lead and coordinate mechanical shutdown and turnaround activities
  • Monitor equipment condition and performance, recommending preventive and corrective maintenance strategies
  • Support HSE initiatives and enforce permit-to-work systems (PTW) at all times



Requirements

  • Mechanical supervision experience in offshore or FPSO projects
  • Proven shipyard construction experience, ideally in Asia
  • Strong background in rotating and static equipment
  • Proficiency in engineering drawings, international codes (ASME, API, ABNT), and CMMS platforms
  • Degree or technical diploma in Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent trade qualification)
  • Valid offshore survival certification (OPITO/HUET); NR-10, NR-33, NR-37 required or to be obtained
  • Fluency in Portuguese mandatory; working English essential

title: Business Development Representative - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.


Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


About the Role:

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you’ll be at the forefront of CloudSEK’s growth. You’ll identify and qualify high-quality leads, nurture relationships with potential clients, and ultimately contribute to our mission of becoming Asia’s leading cybersecurity company.


Requirements:

  • 1-3 years of experience as an SDR/BDR in a SaaS company. If you have worked in the cybersecurity space, that would be awesome! If not, no worries, most of us are from different industries :)
  • We have a proven track record of successfully generating good quality leads, especially C-level.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, both verbal and written.
  • Excellent phone and email etiquette.
  • Know your way around CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot), and data providers (Apollo, Lusha). If not, the team is more than happy to work with you.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and a team player.
  • You are competitive, but with yourself. You set your benchmarks and break them every single quarter.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Prospecting: We will utilize various channels (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Lusha, Apollo) to identify the right accounts and contacts within our target market.
  • Lead qualification : Assess and qualify leads based on specific criteria, ensuring they align with our ideal customer profile.
  • Lead generation: Multi-channel outreach (cold calling, email, Linkedin, looms..etc) to reach out to potential clients and book introductory meetings with the sales team
  • Relationship building: Build rapport and establish trust with prospects, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor.
  • Pipeline development: Contribute to the sales pipeline by consistently generating qualified leads and opportunities.
  • CRM hygiene: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all activities and interactions within our CRM system.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the sales team to ensure a smooth handover of qualified leads and opportunities.
  • Continuous Learning: Stay informed about industry trends, product updates, and competitive landscapes to enhance your outreach.
  • Language: Fluency in English

A companhia, que tem mais de 4 mil colaboradores, é reconhecida como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil pelo ranking Great Place to Work.

Além disso, foi eleita como a 32ª marca mais valiosa pelo Brand Finance Brazil e, por sete vezes, conquistou o Prêmio Consumidor Moderno de Excelência em Serviço ao Cliente na categoria “Locadora de veículos”. Desenvolver, atualizar e analisar relatórios gerenciais, dashboards e apresentações executivas;

Atuar na automação de rotinas financeiras e na melhoria contínua dos processos de precificação;

Gerar insights estratégicos para otimização de preços, equilíbrio entre frota e demanda e maximização da receita;

title: Hardware Engineer
description:
Hardware Electronics Engineer


Be a founding member of Quectel's new LATAM hub in Manaus


Location Manaus, Amazonas, Brazil

Role Hardware Electronics Engineer – LATAM

Level Mid-Level (1-3 years of experience)

Type Full-Time, On-Site

Languages Portuguese & English required · Spanish a plus


About Quectel

Quectel is one of the world's leading suppliers of cellular IoT modules, antennas, and connectivity services, with more than 4,000 professionals across 8 R&D centers and 50+ sales offices worldwide. Our technology powers everything from smart meters and connected cars to industrial robots and point-of-sale terminals — quietly enabling billions of devices to talk to the cloud.


A New Chapter: Quectel in Manaus

This is something special. Quectel is launching a brand-new operation in Manaus, Brazil — and we're building the founding team right now.

Hosted at ICT Manaus (Instituto Centro de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em Tecnologia de Software), an accredited Science, Technology and Innovation Institution under SUFRAMA's CAPDA framework, this new setup will become Quectel's regional engine for R&D, customer enablement, and ANATEL certification across Latin America.


Joining now means more than taking a job — it means shaping a team, a culture, and a way of working from day one. Your fingerprints will be on everything we build here.


Learn more about Quectel:

  • Company website — quectel.com
  • Our history & global footprint — quectel.com/company/history
  • LATAM in action — Furukawa Electric LatAm customer story (Brazil)
  • Follow us on LinkedIn


The Role

We're hiring the founding hardware engineer for Quectel's brand-new Manaus operation. You'll be the first technical point of contact — and the technical voice — for customers across Latin America who are building tomorrow's connected products on Quectel modules: automotive telematics, smart energy, industrial IoT, connected payments, and more.

Because this is a new setup, you won't be slotting into someone else's playbook. You'll define how we review designs, how we work with ANATEL labs, how we support customers, and how we train the next engineers who join the team. You'll work hands-on with hardware, sit across the table from customer engineering teams, and partner with Quectel's global R&D centers to bring solutions home for the LATAM market.


\"Joining a brand-new operation means you're not just doing the work — you're deciding how the work gets done. That's rare, and it's the reason engineers stay.\"


What You'll Do

  • Partner with LATAM customers to understand their products, then design hardware architectures and recommend the right Quectel solutions.
  • Review schematics and PCB layouts in Altium, Cadence, or PADS — and turn your feedback into better, more reliable designs.
  • Get hands-on at the bench: power supply analysis, signal integrity, oscilloscope work, debugging interface and certification issues.
  • Be the trusted technical voice for our LATAM customers — answering tough questions and solving complex problems alongside our global engineering teams.
  • Lead technical discussions with customers and certification labs, including ANATEL homologation activities.
  • Write the application notes, design guidelines, and FAQs that help customers ship faster.
  • Train internal FAE and Sales teams across the region — your expertise will scale across LATAM.
  • Support the project team with BOM preparation for fast, accurate customer quotations.


What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3–5 years of hardware design or hardware support experience — bonus if you've worked in customer-facing or FAE roles.
  • Solid grasp of hardware fundamentals: CPU, memory, PMU, system interfaces.
  • Strong skills in power supply design, power sequencing, charging, and power consumption analysis.
  • Comfortable with serial interfaces — I²C, SPI, UART, USIM — for integration and debug.
  • Confident with bench tools: power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes.
  • Hands-on with at least one EDA tool (Altium Designer, Cadence, or PADS).
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus.


Bonus Points For

  • Experience designing PCBA end-to-end.
  • Deep knowledge of USB 2.0/3.0, USB hub architecture, USB Type-C.
  • Experience with high-speed interfaces: MIPI DSI/CSI, PCIe, SDIO.
  • RF testing experience across cellular (2G/3G/4G/5G) and Wi-Fi 802.11.
  • Background in PC, mobile, server, or FWA system integration.
  • Prior ANATEL homologation experience.
  • Team leadership or technical mentoring experience.


The Tech You'll Work With

  • Quectel's full product portfolio — cellular (5G/LTE/LPWA), GNSS, smart modules, and antennas.
  • Quectel services — including device certification work for ANATEL and other regional bodies.
  • See it in action — Quectel customer stories from automotive, smart metering, agribusiness, and more.


Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Founding-team energy — you're not joining an established office, you're building one. The processes, the culture, the technical playbook — you'll help write it.
  • Real impact from day one — your decisions and designs ship inside products used by millions across LATAM.
  • Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000-person publicly-listed IoT company behind you.
  • Direct line to global R&D — work side-by-side with our R&D centers in China, Europe, and North America while staying rooted in Manaus's growing tech ecosystem.
  • Cutting-edge technology — 5G, LPWA, AI at the edge, smart camera modules, and the next generation of connected devices.
  • Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales.
  • Customer-facing exposure — directly shape how leading LATAM brands build their connected products.
  • Competitive package — attractive compensation, benefits, and the stability of a global market leader.


Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks.
  • Performance bonus / sales commission structure (role dependent).
  • Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance).
  • Health insurance with no co-pay.
  • Life insurance.
  • Paid time off.
  • International travel opportunities — HQ visits and global trade shows.


Ready to Apply?

If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Send your CV (in English) along with a short note about what excites you most about the role. We review applications on a rolling basis.


Apply via: | Browse open roles: quectel.com/recruitment


Quectel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

title: Coordenador(a) Fiscal
description:
Vaga: Coordenador(a) Fiscal


Local: Americana/SP


Muito mais do que “apurar impostos”. Acreditamos que crescimento sustentável exige segurança fiscal, disciplina operacional e inteligência tributária aplicada ao negócio: obrigações em dia, notas corretamente emitidas, cadastros fiscais consistentes, riscos mapeados e decisões tomadas com base em dados confiáveis.


Somos a Energy Petro , uma indústria de lubrificantes 100% brasileira sediada em Americana/SP.


Estamos em expansão e buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) Fiscal  para somar ao nosso time.


O que você fará?


1) Gestão fiscal e conformidade tributária


Coordenar a rotina fiscal da empresa, garantindo o correto cumprimento das obrigações principais e acessórias.


Acompanhar apuração, conferência e recolhimento de tributos diretos e indiretos, especialmente ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS, retenções e demais tributos aplicáveis .


Garantir a correta entrega de obrigações acessórias, como SPED Fiscal, EFD-Contribuições, GIA, DCTF, Reinf  e demais declarações pertinentes.


Assegurar conformidade fiscal nas operações de compra, venda, industrialização, remessa, retorno, bonificações, devoluções e transferências.


Monitorar alterações na legislação tributária e avaliar impactos práticos nas operações da empresa.


2) Operação fiscal integrada ao negócio


Atuar de forma próxima às áreas de Faturamento, Comercial, Compras, Logística, Produção, Financeiro e Contabilidade , garantindo que as regras fiscais estejam corretamente aplicadas na operação.


Apoiar a definição e validação de CFOP, CST, NCM, natureza de operação, alíquotas, benefícios fiscais, substituição tributária e parametrizações fiscais no ERP .


Garantir consistência nos cadastros fiscais de produtos, clientes, fornecedores e operações.


Acompanhar a emissão de notas fiscais, identificando erros recorrentes, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria.

Contribuir para que a operação cresça com segurança, reduzindo retrabalho, autuações, inconsistências e riscos tributários.


3) Análise, controles e gestão de riscos fiscais


Estruturar controles internos para garantir previsibilidade, rastreabilidade e segurança nas informações fiscais.


Realizar análises fiscais preventivas, identificando exposições, créditos tributários, oportunidades de recuperação e pontos de atenção.


Apoiar auditorias, fiscalizações, atendimento a intimações e relacionamento com órgãos públicos, quando necessário.


Construir relatórios gerenciais com indicadores da área fiscal, trazendo clareza sobre riscos, pendências, oportunidades e impactos financeiros.


Atuar de forma analítica na revisão de processos, buscando eficiência, conformidade e melhoria contínua.


4) Liderança, processos e maturidade da área fiscal

Coordenar a equipe fiscal, distribuindo responsabilidades, acompanhando prazos e garantindo qualidade técnica nas entregas.


Organizar rotinas, checklists, calendários fiscais, fluxos de aprovação e critérios de validação.


Elevar a maturidade da área fiscal com visão construtora: organizar o que já existe, melhorar o que precisa e implantar o que falta.


Desenvolver o time, fortalecer senso de dono e promover uma cultura de disciplina, responsabilidade e precisão técnica.


Atuar como referência interna em assuntos fiscais, apoiando decisões estratégicas e operacionais da empresa.


Quem buscamos?


  • Profissional com experiência sólida na área fiscal, preferencialmente em ambiente industrial.
  • Vivência com coordenação de rotinas fiscais, obrigações acessórias, apuração de impostos e parametrizações fiscais.
  • Conhecimento consistente em ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI, PIS, COFINS, CFOP, CST, NCM e SPED .
  • Experiência com operações industriais, faturamento, entrada e saída de mercadorias, remessas, devoluções, industrialização e movimentações interestaduais.
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e atento a detalhes, com capacidade de identificar riscos e propor soluções práticas.
  • Mentalidade construtora, com disposição para estruturar processos, melhorar rotinas e elevar a maturidade da área.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de articulação com diferentes áreas da empresa.
  • Capacidade de liderança, orientação de equipe e gestão de prazos críticos.
  • Domínio de Ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial, Excel/Google Sheets; experiência com ERP é essencial.
  • Conhecimento em Power BI, auditoria fiscal, recuperação de créditos ou planejamento tributário operacional será considerado diferencial.


Benefícios


  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma das empresas que mais cresce no Brasil.
  • Remuneração competitiva.


Se você está pronto(a) para ajudar a Energy Petro  a fortalecer sua segurança fiscal, elevar a maturidade dos processos tributários e sustentar o crescimento da empresa com disciplina, previsibilidade e inteligência, aguardamos a sua candidatura.

description:
About Ocean Network Express (ONE)

Ocean Network Express (ONE) was incepted on July 7, 2017, following the liner service integrations of Kawasaki Kisen Kaisha (“K” LINE), Mitsui O.S.K. Lines (MOL) and Nippon Yusen Kaisha (NYK). The new entity functions from its global headquarters in Singapore, supported by regional headquarters in Hong Kong, Singapore, the United Kingdom, the United States, Dubai and Brazil. ONE is the world’s seventh-largest container carrier with a fleet size of approximately 1.53 million TEU. Operating more than 200 vessels, it offers an expeditious and reliable international network of over 130 services to 120 countries and beyond. ONE is a member of Premier Alliance, a global ocean carrier consortium.

  • For more information, please visit


Applications will be received until: 10/05/2026


Role Responsibilities and Activities:

  • Execute benchmarks on competing shipping lines, empty depots, terminal port agents, analyzing market changes.
  • Evaluate potential new suppliers.
  • Control and report monthly ONE Seal stock, maintaining a minimum safety stock of 3 months.
  • Assist in the import of Seals and RMS to Brazil.

  • Follow Regional M&R instructions.
  • Provide full support to Regional MNR.
  • Analyze operations to identify cost reduction and control opportunities.
  • Verify if the invoice sent by the supplier is correct based on the service approved by MnR via EOS (code, container, value, etc.).
  • Coordinate the recovery of damages to ONE containers.
  • Control claims against local suppliers.
  • Request and approve upgrades according to export demand - 2 weeks before export.
  • Define damaged units (without repair approval) for empty shipments in case of excess stock.
  • Regarding empty shipments of a heavily damaged Reefer, verify if the Reefer service has already removed parts according to previous RHQ MnR instructions before arranging transport to the port.
  • Assist RHQ/GHQ with operational matters.
  • Inform RHQ about all types of operational issues that may affect the local or regional area.
  • Maintain close contact with local partner teams and supplier relations, to handle all different problems before requesting support from other regional teams like PROC, OPS, CF, M&R, YM, etc.
  • Request PTI position according to export demand - 2 weeks before export
  • Inform POD about loaded Reefers with PTI done - In case of empty repo for Reefers with PTI done to supply a location
  • Check the RAD/NOR container list with completed PTI provided by RHQ.
  • MnR instructs suppliers (Reefer Service and Depot) to proceed with full, short, or no PTI according to previous instructions.
  • Check the list of empty containers with PTI provided by RHQ.CF to instruct suppliers (Reefer Service and Depot) to proceed with full, short, or no PTI according to the previous instruction
  • Monitor damaged Reefers with missing parts and push Reefer Service to complete the repair as soon as parts are available

  • Monitor RHQ approval from the depot - within 48 hours of estimate entry into the EOS system.

  • Ensure adequate and prompt handling of equipment malfunction situations.
  • Perform audits on repair estimates issued by local suppliers.
  • Perform audits on local service providers.
  • Authorize repair estimates for local suppliers (up to the limit indicated by Regional MNR).
  • Transfer and request repair authorizations for regional MNR. - Above limits.
  • Arrange for the appropriate disposal of damaged containers.
  • Apply controls over service providers through developed KPI(s).


Required Skills:

  • Intermediate - Advanced English
  • Deep Technical Knowledge in Container Inspections & Repairs
  • Ability to analyze container repair estimates in detail.
  • Full knowledge of repair procedures for adjustments on estimated repairs.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in the MNR area, whether working in a Depot
  • Knowledge of UCIRC
  • Knowledge of CEDEX code
  • Intermediate Excel

Will be considered a plus:

  • Knowledge of IICL, having worked with logistics in a depot or shipping line, experience in a repair shop and entering estimates.
  • BI Tools
  • Power Tools (Query, Pivot, Automate, etc...)
  • Lean and Agile
  • Green Belt certification


Education:

Completed bachelor’s degree in foreign Trade/Logistics/Production/Administration (or currently enrolled)

Technical degree in Refrigeration, Mechanics, or related fields.


Role Skills and Competencies:

description:

About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Esta vaga atende um cliente do segmento de implantes dentários e referência global no setor odontológico.

O projeto tem como objetivo garantir a integridade contábil e otimizar processos financeiros, conectando áreas de negócio e tecnologia em um ambiente altamente integrado.

  • Espanhol avançado e inglês intermediário;

description:

5. Solid understanding of statistics with hands-on experience in conducting and analyzing controlled experiments, and skilled in creating reports and dashboards.

6. Strong communication and collaboration skills; capable of engaging with multiple stakeholders and effectively conveying data findings and recommendations.


Job Highlights

1. Strategic Decision Support: Manage extensive datasets and tackle complex problems to provide holistic data insights driving strategic decisions for customer operations

2. Technological Innovation: Contribute to the ongoing advancement of technologies and tools like data development, Gen/AI, systems and process improvements

3. Fast-paced and Multi-cultural Collaboration: Engage with stakeholders across diverse teams within the company, apply expertise, learn from unforeseen results, investigate root causes, and refine user experiences.

title: Global Therapist: Integrated Critical Incident Response (ICIR)
description:
Our mission: to eliminate every barrier to mental health. At Spring Health, we’re on a mission to revolutionize mental healthcare by removing every barrier that prevents people from getting the help they need, when they need it. Our clinically validated technology, Precision Mental Healthcare, empowers us to deliver the right care at the right time—whether it’s therapy, coaching, medication, or beyond—tailored to each individual’s needs. We proudly partner with over 450 companies, from startups to multinational Fortune 500 corporations, as a leading provider of mental health service, providing care for 10 million people. Our clients include brands you use and know like Microsoft, Target, and Delta Airlines, all of whom trust us to deliver best-in-class outcomes for their employees globally. With our innovative platform, we’ve been able to generate a net positive ROI for employers and we are the only company in our category to earn external validation of net savings for customers. We have raised capital from prominent investors including Generation Investment, Kinnevik, Tiger Global, William K Warren Foundation, Northzone, RRE Ventures, and many more. Thanks to their partnership and our latest Series E Funding, our current valuation has reached $3.3 billion. We’re just getting started—join us on our journey to make mental healthcare accessible to everyone, everywhere.


What You'll Do:

  • Provide counseling to clients with benefits ranging from short-term goal-focused EAP, to employer health plans allowing many sessions as medically necessary.
  • Treat adults who have completed brief, evidence-based online screenings identifying their symptoms and areas of concern.
  • Preferably, also be open to treating additional populations such as children, adolescents, couples, or families.
  • Maintain a calendar displaying your availability and complete session documentation in a timely manner within our scheduling system.
  • Use evidence-based treatment modalities and interventions that are tailored to your client’s needs.
  • Collaborate with our dedicated provider support team, our licensed clinical care navigation team, and our administrative care support team whenever you need assistance.
  • Provide culturally competent and empathetic care, upholding our values of diversity and inclusion for all races, ethnicities, and genders.
  • Integrated Critical Incident Response (ICIR) is a specialized service you can offer through Spring Health. It involves providing timely support to employees at organizations that are navigating workplace-related crises at both the macro level (natural disasters, civil unrest, etc.) and micro level (workforce reductions, death of a co-worker, etc.).
  • Employers might request your support for in-person or virtual group sessions, or 1:1 check-ins. This can include:
  • Group Support: Typically a 1-hour debriefing session with additional resources and follow-up care available through Spring Health.
  • 1:1 Support: 15-minute check-ins with the goal of normalizing the employee’s experience and connecting them to Spring Health for follow-up care if it's appropriate.

Who You Are:

  • You have an unrestricted license to practice counseling (Psychologist, Masters level counselor, etc.) in Brazil. We are not able to accept applications from anyone requiring licensed supervision.
  • You maintain active professional liability insurance at market rates in your approved jurisdiction (country of licensure)
  • Minimum 3 years of total experience within mental health.
  • Have a dedicated office space in which to provide in-person therapy if you choose to provide those services.
  • You're comfortable with technology and are tele-health competent.
  • You have training and experience in evidence-based modalities of care such as CBT, DBT, EMDR, ACT, CPT.
  • You are comfortable with providing safety planning and intervention during situations where a client might present with higher risks.
  • You are committed to quality clinical care and want to expand your capabilities and increase your effectiveness by being informed of client progress or challenges.
  • You like working independently, but would also enjoy having the support of a team and opportunities for connections and collaboration with other providers and our master’s level clinical care navigators.
  • Previous experience delivering CIR services is preferred
  • You must be willing to travel up to one hour from your home to customer locations for delivery of in-person CIR services


Benefits of working with Spring Health:

  • You’ll set your own schedule to fit your professional and personal needs.
  • Work from anywhere, as long as you have a confidential, private location with stable internet.
  • No need to spend time marketing your practice, checking insurance eligibility, collecting fees, or submitting claims---we take care of the administrative work so that you can focus on clinical care.
  • Grow your ability to provide effective care through feedback from evidence-based measures that help you identify what is working with your clients.
  • Join a dynamic community where you will be supported, your work appreciated, and you’ll have the opportunity to help us shape the future of mental health care!


Not sure if you meet every requirement? Research shows that women and people from historically underrepresented communities often hesitate to apply for roles unless they meet every qualification compared to other similarly-qualified candidates. At Spring Health, we are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued, empowered, and supported to Thrive. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply.



Ready to do the most impactful work of your life? Learn more about our values, what it’s like to work here, and how hyper-growth meets impact at Spring Health: Our Values



Our privacy policy:



Spring Health is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable legal requirements. Spring Health is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.
